open.description: True when `waitingOn` is empty: the member's next enrolment may present a new identifier.

schema.description: A community administrator resets one vetter's hidden-vetting (PCS) identifier binding, because the key behind it is lost. The community accepts a new identifier from that member only once no label the old identifier enrolled under is still live, so the member can never be counted twice.

memberDid.description: The member whose binding is reset.

reason.description: Why, in the administrator's words. Kept in the community's audit record.
